title: 応用バイオ統合演習
subtitle: Multidisciplinary Practices for Applied Bioscience
educationalGoal: The goals are to utilize the knowledges learned in Applied Bioscience and to acquire the abilities necessary to achieve your future activities. In this course, you will understand the principles of fundamental phenomena on scientific considerations, and you can plan your future activities. In addition, you can understand and explain the role of a science and engineering engineer in the area of Applied Biotechnology.
advice: The outlines in this course are the history and the interaction with society the fields of the applied biotechnology and the applied chemistry. Also, you introduce your subject of research and understand in the wide range of research fields through presentation and discussion. In addition, you will study the basic principles in the field of food science and technology, and understand the visions of food industry.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience learned and gained prior to the beginning of the course.

activityGoals.body: To be able to scientifically think about the significance and the principle fundamental phenomena and concepts.
To be able to understand the role of Applied Biotechnology in society.
To be able to understand the outline of the educational program in the department of the Applied Bioscience.
To be able to explain the role as an engineer of the science and engineering in the applied biology field.
To be able to introduce the future development of the applied biotechnology field based.

lessons.content: Guidance. Significance at the college of Bioscience. History of Biotechnology and Chemistry. Overview of Biotechnology, Genetic Engineering, and Brain Science.
The role as an engineer of the science and engineering in the field of biotechnology and chemistry. The historical development and social role of the Food Technology.
Foundation lecture of Food technology 1 Inactivation kinetics (1)
Foundation lecture of Food technology 2 Inactivation kinetics (2)
Test 1: Inactivation kinetics (1-2) Foundation lecture of Food technology 3 Interface Science (1)
Test 2: Inactivation kinetics Foundation lecture of Food technology 4 Heat-transfer engineering (1)
Foundation lecture of Food technology 5 Heat-transfer engineering (2)
Test 3: Heat-transfer engineering (1-2) Foundation lecture of Food technology 6 Interface Science (2)
Test 4: Interface Science (2) Foundation lecture of Food technology 7 Biological macromolecular science (1)
Foundation lecture of Food technology 8 Biological macromolecular science (2)
Test 5: Biological macromolecular science (1-2) Introduction of the Food technology research
Presentation of your subject of research and discussion
